def charbox(L):
    # char = b/S cluster near center-right, exclude blue square (rows>=36) and M-structure (cols>=54)
    p=[(r,c) for r in range(15,36) for c in range(20,54) if L[r][c] in ('b','S')]
    if not p: return None
    rs=[x[0] for x in p];cs=[x[1] for x in p]
    return (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs),len(p))
L0=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
print("before:", charbox(L0))
action(['RIGHT'])

print("after RIGHT:", charbox(L1), "changed:", last_action_result.get('board_changed'), "lvl:", last_action_result.get('level_completed'), "done:", last_action_result.get('done'))
